convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ASCtrend indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close/position sizing). Custom indicator buffer interpretation required.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellClose are enabled and no close signal from current bar, EA scans historical bars forward from SignalBar+1 to find the most recent opposite signal to set close flags. This is a historical lookback to determine if an exit signal exists when current bar shows none.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots with MM value; FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin; BALANCE=fraction of balance; LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of (balance-loss) free margin; LOSSBALANCE=fraction of (balance-loss) balance. All handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signals read from ASCtrend indicator buffer 1 (UpValue=buy signal) and buffer 0 (DnValue=sell signal) at SignalBar offset. Signal is valid when value is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE. The EA has an optional historical signal scan: when both open and close flags are enabled for a side but no close signal on current bar, it scans backward through bars to find the last close signal. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are all configurable booleans, allowing signal-only or entry+exit modes. SignalBar=0 forces recalculation every tick; SignalBar>=1 only recalculates on new bar or recount.
python_conversion_notes: ASCtrend is a custom indicator without built-in Python equivalent - its logic must be reverse-engineered or re-implemented. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with margin-mode position sizing - all must be reimplemented. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000), likely need point-value normalization. The historical bar scan for exit signals (lines 132-160) is unusual and must be preserved exactly. The CIsNewBar class and GlobalVariableDel_ also come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
